title: Services Overview
meta_description: Consulting and delivery across eight deep-tech towers, run as one delivery system with shared platforms and named gates.

blocks.x: Eight deep technology towers, one governed delivery system. Each tower carries named services with defined scopes, documented build patterns and evidence packs — this page is the map, and the tower pages are the territory.

The towers are organized by the kind of engineering they do, not by vendor category. Applied AI & GenAI covers models, retrieval and evaluation; Agentic AI & Hyperautomation covers governed autonomy; Data & Lakehouse covers the substrate; Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust covers the controls; Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering covers the estate; Quantum & Advanced Compute covers optimization and cryptography migration; Blockchain & Digital Trust covers shared truth; IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics covers the physical layer.

Most clients enter through a Value Assessment: two weeks, one metric, a signed baseline. If you already know the tower, go straight to a service page — each one documents what ships first, what it touches and how value is proven.
The next step is small and real: one working session on the section map above, your data, and a written feasibility read you can circulate.
